keySentence: Scrooge was cold and very selfish.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: It was Christmas Eve. Scrooge said no to everyone. He did not care about others. Scrooge was cold and very selfish.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: It was Christmas Eve and the streets were full of happy people. Scrooge refused his nephew's kind invitation to Christmas dinner. He turned away men who asked for money to help the poor. Scrooge was cold and very selfish, caring only about money. He went home alone to his dark, cold house without any joy. That night, something very strange was about to happen to him.
